metadata.title: Early Spring Blossoms
metadata.description: I just wanted to share some of the beautiful things in bloom in my garden! Cherry, forsythia daffodils and more! What's happening in your Garden?

hi there welcome back to get gardening!
this definitely has to be one of my

favorite times of the year I love coming
home from work seeing all the changes

that happen in the course of a day
yesterday these high since weren't open

I love that these have a hint of blue in
them touched with violet I love seeing

absolutely everything at this time of
the year even just seeing the peony come

up this is a hot coral colored one makes
me so excited so many things are

happening in the garden that I would
love to show you what are some of the

things that are blooming in your garden
I'd love to hear from you and hear about

some of the things that are happening in
your garden but right now the daffodils

over here are just looking wonderful
these are a small version of daffodils

that they open and the comfort on them
is a lighter yellow and then it starts

darkening becomes a deeper orange color
as it ages can see them there with the

lupins in the background even the
boxwood looks beautiful I love boxwoods
bluebells

I literally come home from work and I
could spend hours just looking at

everything it just amazes me that all of
a sudden this daffodil right here

starting open and I just know in a day
or two it's going to be open to adding

some color to the garden so many things
just changed so fast I wish I was here

just to see it all I could just spend
hours looking in the garden these purple

reticulata irises opened I think they
look fantastic touch with orange I've

never had these before and this year
I've had purple blue and yellow and I've

loved them all some hyacinth in the
background my cherry tree looks oh so

marvelous I wanted to come out and take
a video of it for a few days and I

haven't but the cherry tree I think
represents the whole thing about

gardening sort of that then quality
appreciate the moment while it's here

and boy am I appreciating my cherry
blossoms I absolutely love them this

tree was shorter than I was three years
ago and now it's about twice as tall as
me my first issue is finally have popped

this one in the corner here has a
lighter yellow tint to it and up across

the garden is another one that is just
such a deep gold so I'm enjoying my

garden I can't wait for all the things
still to come but at this moment things

couldn't look more beautiful than they
do right now in my garden hopefully your

garden looks just as beautiful and
you're just as excited as I am so

hopefully you'll be able to get out
there and gets gardening thanks so much
for watching

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to any of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an
     agent traverses space — first-person walking tours (museum, store,
     home, city street), driving / cycling / hiking POV footage, drone
     fly-throughs of indoor or outdoor scenes, room/house walkthroughs.
     The camera's translation through the environment IS the main content.
     Does NOT count: a stationary tripod with someone talking; a tutorial
     filmed in one place; b-roll where the camera only pans or zooms but
     does not translate; sports footage where the player moves but the
     camera stays put.
   A video can match zero, one, or multiple domains. Be strict — when in
   doubt, say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
